 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Jared Cannonier and Ikram Aliskerov kick off the UFC Fight Night 294 main card at ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar. Check out this quick breakdown of the matchup from MMA Junkie analyst Dan Tom. 
 Last event's results: 1-3-1
 UFC main cards, 2026: 126-82-2
 Jared Cannonier vs. Ikram Aliskerov UFC Fight Night 294 preview
 Cannonier (18-10 MMA, 11-10 UFC) is in a rough stretch, going 1-4 over his last five outings. The former title challenger's TKO win over Gregory Rodrigues is sandwiched between losses to Nassourdine Imavov , Caio Borralho, Michael Page, and Christian Leroy Duncan.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Aliskerov (18-2 MMA, 5-1 UFC) has plenty of momentum on his side as a winner of three straight. His current run includes wins over Andre Muniz, Jun Yong Park and Brunno Ferreira.
 Jared Cannonier vs. Ikram Aliskerov UFC Fight Night 294 expert pick, prediction
 Despite having perfect main-card openers listed above and below this fight, the UFC matchmakers can't help but force-feed us middleweight features at any opportunity.
 In the matchmakers' defense, this fight between Ikram Aliskerov and Jared Cannonier is a meaningful matchup between ranked fighters.
 However, with Aliskerov being 4-1 in his last five fights while Cannonier currently mirrors those numbers at 1-4, it's not hard to figure out who this potential crossroads fight favors on paper.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cannonier has been a traditional tough out and live dog in the latter stages of his career, but I suspect that strong grapplers remain a form of stylistic kryptonite for "Tha Killa Gorilla."
 Even though I don't disagree with Aliskerov detractors who claim that he's been underwhelming as of late, I have a sneaky suspicion that the Dagestani becomes the first man to submit Jared Cannonier with a kimura in Round 2.
 Watch UFC Fight Night 294 with Paramount+ 
 Jared Cannonier vs. Ikram Aliskerov UFC Fight Night 294 odds
 The oddsmakers and the public favor the fighter from Dagestan, listing Aliskerov -295 and Cannonier +240 via FanDuel.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jared Cannonier vs. Ikram Aliskerov UFC Fight Night 294 start time, how to watch
 As the main card opener, Cannonier and Aliskerov are expected to walk to the cage at approximately 12:15 p.m. ET. The fight streams live on Paramount+ .
